cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've made you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Can you approve the bus route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only volunteered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Good catch. Correct it and initial it; then we both own the plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together. I'll introduce you as our transport lead and take the questions beside you.

mechanism: A promotes its former trip-planning pupil into signed route ownership and public transport responsibility, using praise and graduation pressure to secure help.
confusable: Not granting a flattering title alone: B is asked to initial the corrected route and share parent questions about results.
comparison: Shared equipment cost decisions versus shared public explanation of travel delays.
